digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI/CD — Gerrit Verified workflow
propositions: Ubuntu default-tier pytest jobs occupy 30.2 runner-minutes per Verified run (py3.11=615s, py3.12=634s, py3.13=563s baseline) while macOS completion path remains critical at 22m15s

Bridge cadence test _bridge_schedule() parses workflow YAML 1,440 times inside comprehension loop at 7.653s cost when parse-once reuse costs 0.00106s, saving 5.70 runner-minutes per run without changing exhaustiveness contract

Pandoc corpus and hardening tests invoke real Pandoc 3,421 times (884 units × 2 suites with 1 redundant legacy subprocess per unit) where 883 legacy invocations can use immutable expected fixtures while keeping 884 live product conversions, saving processor startup overhead

Static policy for complexity-lock runs OS/Python-invariant checks in every matrix cell (52–55s per Ubuntu cell) instead of once outside matrix, generating 2.57 runner-minutes redundant work per Verified run

AST provenance fixture setup spends 46–49s on three Ubuntu cells discovering parent/caller relationships via 9.54M ast.walk iterations when one-time index caching can preserve exact tuples and all guards

Full hot-path Pandoc corpus substitution with static golden fixtures requires explicit ADR 0095 supersession and cannot proceed as implementation detail; bounded live contract plus representative probes with weekly/manual full replay preserves coverage while requiring architecture confirmation
